text:
Alex: Quick sync — we're finalizing the plan to make default model selection explicit and roll out a version header. Need owners for SDK updates, docs, runtime fallback, and comms. TL;DR: introduce `X-Redwood-Model` header (default `redwood-default@latest`), deprecate implicit model fallback in 8 weeks. Thoughts?

Morgan: +1 on header. SDK changes are straightforward but we'll need a migration warning in the JS/py clients and a minor semver bump. I can own the SDK patches. @alex do we want a feature-flag for the beta period?

Priya: Agree. Feature-flag for SDKs is good. For docs we should include a migration snippet and a sample curl. Also recommend a server-side opt-out for customers who rely on implicit behavior (admin toggle).

Ryan: Quick question on backward compatibility: if a customer sets no header during the deprecation window, will requests continue to be served by the current default model, or will we return an error? We should avoid 4xx.

Sam: Runtime note — we can keep serving the existing default as a compatibility fallback for the deprecation window, but we should emit a warning header `X-Redwood-Warning: model-default-deprecation` so analytics picks it up. After window ends, fallback becomes a lower-priority variant and we either route to a pinned model or return 410 with a clear message.

Jess: For comms: propose two announcements — an initial heads-up (8 weeks out) and a follow-up migration guide + SDK release (2 weeks before enforcement). Also include examples for webhooks and rate-limit impacts. I can draft the copy. :memo:

deploy-bot: FYI — added a checklist item to the infra board: `api: model-header-rollout` (assignee: unassigned). Link: https://rwd.company/boards/infra/1234

Morgan: SDK snippet we plan to add:

```
// Node SDK example
const res = client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-default@latest', // explicit model param
  headers: {'X-Redwood-Model': 'redwood-7b-q4f' }
});
```

Priya: Docs snippet for curl:

```
curl -H "X-Redwood-Model: redwood-7b-q4f" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Ryan: +1 on warning header. Also add an API-level telemetry flag so we can slice usage by customers still hitting implicit default. We should coordinate with billing to avoid surprise usage changes.

Sam: Runtime follow-up — we'll implement a deprecation window toggle in config: `model_deprecation: {enabled: true, enforcement_date: "2026-05-01T00:00:00Z"}`. Will do a canary rollout (10% traffic) first and watch latency/error spikes.

Alex: Action items I heard:
- Morgan: SDK patches + feature-flag PR (due in 1 week)
- Priya: Docs + migration guide draft (due in 2 weeks)
- Sam: Runtime toggle + canary plan (initial test in 3 days)
- Jess: Comms copy + schedule (announce in 8 weeks)
- Ryan: Telemetry + billing sync
- deploy-bot: Add owners to infra board

Please reply if I missed anything. If no objections I'll open the formal RFC and start the deprecation tracker. :eyes:

Jess: One more thing — recommend we include a small sample of recommended model pins for common workloads (chat, embeddings). I can compile a short matrix.

Alex: Sounds good. RFC incoming by EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
